note: the per-append cost must not grow with the file's retained extent count; a rising curve means the extent map has regressed to O(E) per write (structural sharing lost). Measured on this host; run-to-run variance is expected.
method: one 4 KiB append at EOF per transaction to a single file; equal durability (each append is its own authoritatively committed transaction with its durability barrier); mean is over appends after a fixed warm-up, on a fresh volume per point.
extent_growth: extents grow 1:1 with appends by construction (each 4 KiB write's bytes live at a distinct, non-contiguous log offset, so logical extents cannot coalesce); the cost must be flat regardless.
